quest.title: A Surprise From a Fellow Comics Fan
quest.description: Yoimiya seems to be looking for you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Summer Festival Fish x5, Guide to Transience x3

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! What a surprise, running into you in Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I've never been anywhere with a climate like this before. It's so cold! But wow, what an experience!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I've had my first snowball fight, built my first snowman... Oh, and the comics are a nice surprise!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: The Soulblazer Saga is super popular in Inazuma, but I totally wasn't expecting to find so many people that read it.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I had a great chat with some Natlanese fans earlier. It really got me inspired, so... I ended up making a character stand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: ...Oh, sorry, lemme backtrack a little. Have you ever heard of The Soulblazer Saga?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Yoimiya about the Legion of Soulblazers...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No way! Your friends are into it too? What a funny coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: In that case, lemme give you this character stand of Fietena. Hehe, she'll be right at home in the Legion of Soulblazers!
